annotations.title: Inflation calculator (future cost and purchasing power)

description: Use when a user asks what inflation does to money, e.g. "what will $100 be worth in 10 years with inflation?", "how much will a $50,000 salary need to be in 20 years?" or "how much purchasing power does cash lose at 3% inflation?". Future cost of something priced today and the purchasing power of today's money in the future (in today's dollars), plus how long prices take to double. Inflation defaults to 3% a year, an assumption, not a forecast. Example: $100 kept as cash for 10 years at 3% buys what $74.41 buys today.
